## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~8.42 GB, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/maya-research](https://huggingface.co/maya-research/maya1))
   
   ```sh
   pip install vllm snac soundfile && wget https://huggingface.co/maya-research/maya1/resolve/main/vllm_streaming_inference.py && python vllm_streaming_inference.py
   ```

Other versions: BF16 (TRANSFORMERS + SNAC) (~6.71 GB) `pip install torch transformers snac soundfile accelerate && python -c "import torch, soundfile as sf; from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer; from snac import SNAC; model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('maya-research/maya1', torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map='auto', trust_remote_code=True); tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('maya-research/maya1', trust_remote_code=True); device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'; snac_model = SNAC.from_pretrained('hubertsiuzdak/snac_24khz').eval().to(device); description = 'Realistic male voice in the 30s age with american accent. Normal pitch, warm timbre, conversational pacing.'; text = 'Hello! This is Maya1 <laugh_harder> the best open source voice AI model with emotions.'; prompt = tokenizer.decode([128259]) + tokenizer.bos_token + f'<description=\"{description}\"> {text}' + tokenizer.decode([128009]) + tokenizer.decode([128260]) + tokenizer.decode([128261]) + tokenizer.decode([128257]); inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors='pt').items()}; outputs = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=2048, min_new_tokens=28, temperature=0.4, top_p=0.9, repetition_penalty=1.1, do_sample=True, eos_token_id=128258, pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id); ids = outputs[0, inputs['input_ids'].shape[1]:].tolist(); ids = ids[:ids.index(128258)] if 128258 in ids else ids; codes = [t for t in ids if 128266 <= t <= 156937]; n = len(codes) // 7; levels = [[(codes[7*i] - 128266) % 4096 for i in range(n)], [(codes[7*i+j] - 128266) % 4096 for i in range(n) for j in (1, 4)], [(codes[7*i+j] - 128266) % 4096 for i in range(n) for j in (2, 3, 5, 6)]]; z_q = snac_model.quantizer.from_codes([torch.tensor(l, dtype=torch.long, device=device).unsqueeze(0) for l in levels]); audio = snac_model.decoder(z_q)[0, 0].detach().cpu().numpy(); audio = audio[2048:] if len(audio) > 2048 else audio; sf.write('output.wav', audio, 24000)"`
